use default

permute[T](digits: Collections.List[int], items: Collections.List[T])
        -> LIST[T] is
    let result = LIST(items)

    for (place, digit) in digits |> index() do
        if digit > 0 then
            let moved = result[place + digit]

            result.remove_at(place + digit)
            result.insert(place, moved)
        fi
    od

    return result
si

factorial_base_numbers(places: int) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    let digits = LIST()

    for _ in 0..places do
        digits.add(0)
    od

    while true do
        yield LIST(digits)

        let place mut = places - 1

        while place >= 0 /\ digits[place] == places - place do
            digits[place] = 0
            place = place - 1
        od

        if place < 0 then
            return
        fi

        digits[place] = digits[place] + 1
    od
si

parse_digits(text: string) -> LIST[int] =>
    text.split(['.']) |> map(part => int.parse(part)) |> collect_list()

show[T](digits: Collections.List[int], items: Collections.List[T]) is
    let number = digits |> map(d => "{d}") |> join(".")
    let arrangement =
        permute(digits, items) |> map(i => "{i}") |> join("")

    write_line("{number} -> {arrangement}")
si

for digits in factorial_base_numbers(3) do
    show(digits, [0, 1, 2, 3])
od

write_line("")
let permutations_of_eleven = factorial_base_numbers(10) |> count()
